help.text: The panel follows After Effects' current display language automatically. Work size is the longest edge; 0 uses full resolution. Serpentine affects Floyd–Steinberg only. Dithering and CRT/VHS have independent switches. CRT/VHS uses GPU float buffers and composition time.
about.text:
FYLM Pixel Art 0.6
Dithering and pixel-art effects, shipped with CRT/VHS and ShaderGlass under FYLM Plugins. AE multi-frame rendering; 8/16-bit host I/O.
